changelog:
VIUMO v1.1.5 • User-Requested Overhaul 🚀

What's New & Fixed:
• Seamless episode resuming & Next Episode flow.
• Offline subtitles now fully supported with transparent overlays.
• Custom simultaneous download limits.
• Auto-delete finished movies & empty corrupted file cleanup.
• Redesigned Delete UI.

Built directly from your feedback. Thank you for making Viumo better! ❤️
